Houndstone

Ghost

Paldea · Generation 9

Houndstone is a Ghost-type Ghost Dog Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 2 m tall and weighs 15 kg. It evolves from Greavard. Its highest base stat is Attack (101), with a base stat total of 488.
